proposed_connector.name: state_re_licensing.query_brokerage_active_markets
proposed_connector.description: State real-estate commission registries (e.g. Arizona DRE, Texas TREC, California DRE) listing active broker licenses by entity name and jurisdiction; a real iBuyer must be licensed where it transacts.
proposed_connector.sample_invocation: GET each state's public licensee search for 'Opendoor' and confirm an active brokerage/salesperson license in each named market state (AZ, TX, CA, FL, GA, NV, CO, NC, TN, OH, ...).
proposed_connector.rationale: Opendoor's claim of operating in 50 named markets is structurally adjudicated by the relevant state real-estate licensing registry: it cannot legally purchase/resell homes in a market without an active brokerage or transaction license. No single national registry exists; the connector aggregates per-state lookups.
proposed_connector.completeness: Coverage limited to states with public license search; some states require FOIA

claims.extraction_notes: No catalog source covers state real-estate broker licensure. edgar_fts cannot verify market presence. Proposed connector adjudicates whether the named-market footprint is real.

proposed_connector.name: sec_exhibits.query_credit_agreements
proposed_connector.description: SEC EDGAR exhibit-level search for credit-agreement exhibits (Ex-10.x) filed by issuer CIK; counts and dates the credit agreements / amendments backing each named facility.
proposed_connector.sample_invocation: GET efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22Revolving+Facility+2018-2%22&ciks=0001801169 and parse the exhibit hits to verify each named facility has a corresponding filed credit agreement and any amendments.
proposed_connector.rationale: Each named ABS revolving / term / mezzanine facility should have a corresponding credit-agreement exhibit filed with the SEC (typically as Ex-10.x with an 8-K or 10-Q). Counting these adjudicates whether the 11 facilities are real legal documents and whether their stated maturities have been amended pre-cutoff.
proposed_connector.completeness: All SEC issuers with public exhibits

claims.extraction_notes: edgar_fts can partially do this with single-token searches like 'Revolving Facility 2018-2', but a dedicated exhibit-level connector cleanly maps each named facility to a contract. Phase 2 can use edgar_fts as a fallback while the proposed connector is built.

proposed_connector.name: pacer_courtlistener.query_case_by_docket
proposed_connector.description: CourtListener / RECAP free public-court-docket lookup for federal district-court cases by case number; returns case caption, filing date, current status, and docket entries.
proposed_connector.rationale: Securities-class-action existence and case-status claims are structurally adjudicated by the federal court docket. CourtListener / RECAP mirror PACER and are free. The framework can verify the case exists, the consolidation occurred, and the MTD was filed on the asserted date.

claims.extraction_notes: edgar_fts could corroborate via plaintiffs' 8-K filings only when a class-period change is material; the federal-docket connector is the authoritative registry.

proposed_connector.name: county_assessor.query_commercial_tenant
proposed_connector.description: Maricopa County (AZ) and Gwinnett County (GA) assessor parcel-and-tenant records for commercial buildings; confirms Opendoor as tenant-of-record at a parcel matching the claimed footprint.
proposed_connector.sample_invocation: Search Maricopa assessor for parcels with 'Opendoor' tenant or owner in Tempe; confirm one parcel exists. Repeat for Gwinnett County (Duluth).

claims.claim_text: Opendoor wound down its mortgage lending and brokerage services starting in November 2022 (as part of a 550-employee restructuring), and executed two additional workforce reductions in 2023: a 22% reduction (~560 employees) announced April 18, 2023, and a 6% reduction (~120 employees) in Q4 2023.
claims.source_quote: On April 18, 2023, the Company announced a workforce reduction of approximately 560 employees, representing approximately 22 % of the Company s workforce at that time and primarily impacting volume-based roles. ... In November 2022, the Company initiated a workforce reduction of 550 employees, which included: (i) reducing the Company s headcount by 18 % and (ii) winding down of our mortgage lending and brokerage services.
claims.subject: Opendoor
claims.object_value: Mortgage wind-down Nov 2022; 560 RIF Apr 2023; 120 RIF Q4 2023
claims.extraction_notes: Material restructurings and discontinuance of a business line trigger 8-K Item 2.05 disclosures. Counting 8-Ks from Opendoor over Nov 2022 - 2023 corroborates the cadence of restructuring events. The mortgage-subsidiary's NMLS lender license being surrendered would also be a registry-side adjudication (potential future NMLS connector).

claims.claim_text: Opendoor used asset-backed financing through special-purpose entities and consolidated VIEs to finance its real estate inventory purchases.
claims.source_quote: The Company has established certain special purpose entities ( SPEs ) for the purpose of financing the Company s purchase and renovation of real estate inventory through the issuance of asset-backed debt. The Company is the primary beneficiary of the various variable interest entities ( VIE ) within these financing structures and consolidates these VIEs.
claims.subject: Opendoor financing SPEs
claims.extraction_notes: If OPEN's ABS facilities are public/registered Reg AB-II structures, ABS-15G/ABS-EE/10-D filings would show. Note: many real-estate-asset-backed warehouse facilities are private bank facilities that do NOT trigger Reg AB filings. ZERO results here is therefore NOT a contradiction; it just means the financing is bilateral bank facilities (consistent with the 10-K's description of revolving facilities by counterparty).
